name: pairwire
description: An experimental browser-based peer-to-peer messaging app built with WebRTC.

scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.test: npm run clean:test && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run hygiene:check && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.clean:test: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('.test-dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
